newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila suspends trading due to floods-traders.
newsitem.headline: Manila suspends trading due to floods-traders.

text.p: Trading on the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) has been suspended due to heavy flooding in the capital, traders said on Monday.
"The market is experiencing confusion right now, most brokerage houses have no traders due to this bad weather," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities Inc said.
Garcia said trading was suspended at 9:38 a.m. (0138 GMT). The market opened almost flat in thin volume at 2,598.2 points.

"We suspended trading due to the weather conditions...we are waiting official word from the Bankers Association of the Philippines on whether there is clearing," Philippine Stock Exchange governor Harry Liu told Reuters.
Liu said that if there is no clearing, trading will automatically be suspended for the rest of the day.
The Bankers Association has already issued a public statement saying there would be no cheque clearing today.
Heavy overnight rains flooded much of the capital on Monday with some offices shutting down for the day.
